correctness.rationale: Exact factorization LQ; conic point count p-chi_p(-3) and intersection count 1+chi_p(-c/3). A unit Jacobian 6a at every crossing gives a local coordinate bijection; the exact count of pairs uv=0 at each p-adic crossing is p^(k-1)(1+(k-1)(p-1)). The remaining smooth points each contribute p^(k-1) lifts. The p=3 unit-coefficient isometry proves its two cases. All quantifiers and k=1 boundaries are handled. An independent standalone checker passed 474 full histograms and direct ordered-pair spot checks.

The 2003 finite-field cubic root-count statements can help at k=1 but do not fix the number of lifts at transverse crossing points, which adds (k-1)(p-1) in the proved formula.

value.rationale: The exact fiber second moment refines permutation classification, measures the extent of residue collisions and gives a sharp k=1 vs k>=2 character-class ordering reversal across all primes p>=5. The critical class grows linearly with lift depth after normalization while the other is constant. This is a coherent infinite-family structural law, not a small-case or arbitrary-index computation.
